name: Mirrors
source:
Follow the story of Robin, a girl whose life has been cursed by a shadow that visited her when she was ten. After a tragic event, her visions began to go haywire.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
跟随女孩罗宾走进她的故事。十岁时，一个黑影曾来找她，从此她的一生便背负着诅咒。一场悲剧过后，她眼前的幻象开始彻底失控。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
